VehicleControlUnit.label: VehicleControlUnit
VehicleControlUnit.description: This Object provides the information to represent a generic VCU(vehicle control unit).

Vehicle_UI_State.label: Vehicle UI State
Vehicle_UI_State.description: The UI state of the vehicle. 0: idle 1: driving 2: charging 3: limp-home 4-15: reserved for future use

Vehicle_Shift_Status.label: Vehicle Shift Status
Vehicle_Shift_Status.description: Current shift status of the vehicle. 0: Neutral 1: Forward 2: Reverse

Vehicle_AP_Position.label: Vehicle AP Position
Vehicle_AP_Position.description: Current position of the accelerator pedal.

Vehicle_Power.label: Vehicle Power
Vehicle_Power.description: Current power of drive output/regenerative braking.

Vehicle_Drive_Energy.label: Vehicle Drive Energy
Vehicle_Drive_Energy.description: Accumulated drive energy of the vehicle.

Vehicle_Energy_Consumption_Efficiency.label: Vehicle Energy Consumption Efficiency
Vehicle_Energy_Consumption_Efficiency.description: Energy consumption efficiency of the vehicle.

Vehicle_Estimated_Mileage.label: Vehicle Estimated Mileage
Vehicle_Estimated_Mileage.description: Estimated mileage of current battery capacity.

Vehicle_Charge_Cable_Status.label: Vehicle Charge Cable Status
Vehicle_Charge_Cable_Status.description: Whether the charge cable is connected or not. 0: unconnected 1: connected

Vehicle_Charge_Status.label: Vehicle Charge Status
Vehicle_Charge_Status.description: Charging status of the vehicle. 1: non-charge mode 2: charging 3: charge completed 4: charging abort abnormally

Battery_Pack_Remaining_Capacity.label: Battery Pack Remaining Capacity
Battery_Pack_Remaining_Capacity.description: Remaining capacity of the battery pack

Battery_Pack_SOC.label: Battery Pack SOC
Battery_Pack_SOC.description: SOC(state of charge) of the battery pack

Battery_Pack_SOH.label: Battery Pack SOH
Battery_Pack_SOH.description: SOH(state of health) of the battery pack

Battery_Cell_MinVolt.label: Battery Cell MinVolt
Battery_Cell_MinVolt.description: Minimum voltage of the battery module (with parallel connection of cells)

Battery_Cell_MaxVolt.label: Battery Cell MaxVolt
Battery_Cell_MaxVolt.description: Maximum voltage of the battery module (with parallel connection of cells)

Battery_Module_MinTemp.label: Battery Module MinTemp
Battery_Module_MinTemp.description: Minimum temperature of the battery module

Battery_Module_MaxTemp.label: Battery Module MaxTemp
Battery_Module_MaxTemp.description: Maximum temperature of the battery module

Battery_Connection_Status.label: Battery Connection Status
Battery_Connection_Status.description: Whether the battery is connected or not. 0: unconnected 1: connected

MCU_Voltage.label: MCU Voltage
MCU_Voltage.description: Voltage of the MCU(motor control unit)

Motor_OT_Warning.label: Motor OT Warning
Motor_OT_Warning.description: Whether the motor is OT or not. 0: normal 1: OT warning

MCU_OT_Warning.label: MCU OT Warning
MCU_OT_Warning.description: Whether the MCU is OT or not. 0: normal 1: OT warning

Battery_Pack_OT_Warning.label: Battery Pack OT Warning
Battery_Pack_OT_Warning.description: Whether the battery pack is OT or not. 0: normal 1: OT warning

MCU_fault.label: MCU fault
MCU_fault.description: Status of MCU. 0: normal 1: level 1 minor fault 2: level 2 critical fault

Motor_Error.label: Motor Error
Motor_Error.description: Status of the battery pack. 0: normal 1: level D25 minor fault 2: level 2 critical fault
